notes.title: Fable Grove v1.2 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110639/bbe33f854122fa6eb879d03ea32b0194fa0c4b70.png

Hunter Mode

Hunter Mode is here! Up your challenge in Fable Grove by Entering Hunter Mode through the Shop tab. For the low, low cost of 20 Crystals, you can enrage all Monsters spawned, causing them to attack you! While Hunter Mode is active, you gain DOUBLE XP and 5 Crystals per capture.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110639/75aca9db5202dac44c023aa89f3fc3dcce4e6245.png


New Achievements


 Stay in Hunter Mode for 5 minutes at once to get a new achievement!
 Stay in Hunter Mode for 10 minutes at once to get a new achievement!
 Capture one of every monster to get a new achievement!
 Own one of every Shiny monster to get a new achievement!


Happy hunting!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Some great suggestions came in through our Discord! Here are the list of changes in this patch:


 Added Screen Resolution setting and Windowed Mode in the Game Menu
 Added the Settings tab to the Title screen
 Added a loading screen when you press Play to make the game feel more responsive


I must admit, I'm now playing Fable Grove in a smaller resolution in Windowed mode. I think this is a fantastic addition for gamers who play multiple clicker games at the same time.

As usual, feel free to drop into our Discord to speak to me about anything! Thanks all.

notes.title: Fable Grove V1.1 Update
notes.content:
https://i.ibb.co/vvMJ5Jv/Features-616-x-200-px-1.png

It's been a hectic few days since Early Access Release and many issues have been uncovered thanks to feedback from players which I really appreciate. New ideas have also been passed around on our Discord which I am working hard to implement. Thanks to everyone on there for being so supportive of this project, it's still early days but and there is a lot to improve upon before full release.

Unfortunately Fable Grove is getting a rather large amount of negative feedback through reviews for being a clicker game which incorporates marketplace items. I understand why this is the case; many Steam users are tired of seeing auto clicker games which have seemingly no gameplay and target the marketplace as a source of quick-win money. All I can do is continue developing Fable Grove to the point where it clearly distinguishes itself from others in the same category. I hope you all have the patience to see this unfold.

With that being said, here are the list of changes implemented for this update. Any new features added will have a brief rationale attached just so I can explain why I've chosen to implement them.

New Features

Buddy System Alpha

Clicking one of your Shiny Monsters in your MonLog will now summon it as a Buddy! Your buddy will move around the screen, click monsters if it can reach them, and rest once it runs out of energy (the energy is displayed on the new bar on the left). Different rarity monsters have different stats, for example Legendary monsters move faster and click faster. 

Your Buddy also levels up, increasing it's movement speed (up to a cap of 400), click speed (up to a cap of 0.3 per second) and maximum energy (up to a cap of 100). Each Monster in your MonLog will have its own set of stats, so you have to level each one up.

Rationale: Clicker games with Steam Marketplace items don't tend to have a use for the Marketplace items, causing upset. This is the first set of changes in place to actually give your Shiny Monsters a use in game. More are on their way. I don't want players to want to trade or sell their favourite Shinies, they should be kept and used in game.

Removed Intro & Added Title Screen

One of the most upvoted reviews on our Early Access Release so far is "Even the intro made me angry.", so I've taken that feedback on board and added a Title Screen to replace the old intro. Monsters peek around the edge, and I've also included a Discord button so more players can hop in and give their suggestions for improvements. Hopefully, xRaiden, this change makes you feel less angry? :) (I'm joking, despite the bluntness of your review, I agree with you that it needed to change)

Settings will be added to the Title Screen as soon as I have finished my Screen Resolution changes (currently encountering a number of bugs with this so held it back for this update)

Bug Fixes


 Notifications no longer stop you from clicking monsters! Great spot from our Discord members and a really frustrating one I'm sure that has been fixed.
 Fixed Tooltips not disappearing in certain circumstances. They should now properly appear and disappear.
 Added a fix for certain achievements not activating



Please drop by our Discord if you encounter any issues or bugs, or if you just want to drop by to recommend a feature, I'm extremely active on there and open to all ideas! Thanks.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 3
notes.content: - Fixed achievement granting for clicks and monsters caught. You'll need to catch 1 more to trigger this change :)

notes.title: Quick Early Access Patch 2
notes.content:
- Steam Marketplace rewards work properly now! Thanks for your patience! Catching a Shiny will go straight into your Steam Inventory.
- Shiny Monsters from your Steam Inventory appear correctly in your MonLog. Good luck filling up your MonLog with shinies! I'll add achievements soon for this!

Happy hunting! Join our Discord if you want to chat with the dev.

notes.title: Quick Early Access Patch 1
notes.content: It looks like our Steam Inventory integration has some issues so I am scrambling to sort that as soon as possible. In the meantime, this patch will stop players from abusing clicker software to cheat in our scoreboards (yes, I'm looking at you Madhunter, cheating isn't cool!)
